svg.title: Product Service AWS architecture
svg.desc: AWS architecture diagram showing the customer browser loading a React frontend from private S3 through CloudFront and calling a public HTTPS API protected by WAF and an internet-facing ALB. ECS Fargate tasks and RDS run in private subnets. Cognito provides customer authentication. A separate order-processing example uses Lambda and DynamoDB. CodePipeline, CodeBuild, ECR, and CodeDeploy deploy the API using ECS blue/green releases.
svg.text: Public subnets - internet-facing ALB in 2+ Availability Zones
Private subnets - ECS tasks (no public IPs) and RDS
AWS architecture icons. Diagram reflects repository templates; AWS resources are not claimed as deployed.
